notes.deenhindi-nasai:2737: Both complete own fields were read. The parenthetical I-am-saying-this-so supplies the source-rendered purpose/utterance link and should remain with explicit qualification; do not assert that these explanatory words are independently verbatim Muawiya speech. Preserve the negative/although contrast and actual supplied names without resolving ritual history. The Urdu numbered marker is context.
notes.deenhindi-nasai:2738: Both full fields were read independently. The first actual Batha encounter supplies the talbiya dialogue, no-hady response and tawaf/sai/end-ihram commands. The later passage supplies Abu Musa's own practice during the named caliphates, an actual Hajj-season interruption, his warning to listeners and an actual exchange with the source-designated Amir alMu'minin containing a quoted Quran phrase and Sunnah argument. This actual main numbered historical exchange remains distinct from appended compiler legal commentary. Retain the one-time occasion parenthesis as material transition. Hindi omits the sai/woman-visit link before its she-combed/washed predicate, omits part of the later arrival/request bridge and ends with a broken conditional/predicate; all missing subjects, links and hady-ending wording stay missing. Urdu's fuller report must not repair Hindi. Do not insert a ruler's personal name where the own exchange gives only the title. Preserve each nested voice and the supplied verse as part of that attributed reply, without independent legal or historical certification.
notes.deenhindi-nasai:2741: Both full own fields contain Aisha's only-Hajj departure, Sarf menstruation/crying scene, the actual question/answer and the perform-everything-except-tawaf instruction. notes.deenhindi-nasai:2743: Both full own fields contain Ja'far's actual visit/question to Jabir followed by the supplied Hajj report and Ali dialogue. Hindi omits the reply bridge, Ali/Yemen identification in that clause, and prints the finite but subject-defective came-with-a-stick wording; preserve that literal defect and do not import the Urdu subject, place, or sacrifice-animal wording. The until-Hajj-completion parenthesis materially limits that command and must remain source-rendered scope, without claiming independently verbatim historical wording.
